title: Media manifest
description: The media.json a job's media.ts writes into FLAX_AGENTS_MEDIA_DIR: every media file with its size and sha256, a hash over them all, and job-specific data for collect.ts. Rules the schema cannot say (each file exists and matches, the total size, the hash) are checked by the runner.

path.description: Relative to the media directory: names of letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores, separated by /; no . or .. names, no leading /.

type.description: The media type, such as video/mp4, text/vtt or image/png.

hash.description: sha256 hex of the lines `<path> <sha256>`, one per file, sorted, joined with a newline and no newline at the end.

data.description: Job-specific JSON that collect.ts may pass on to the model, such as a scene list, timings or screenshot ids.
